Author: Krishan Pahal

High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:218722

Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 12027 of 2023
Applicant :- Baburam

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Avinash Pandey
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Atmaram Nadiwal,Dinesh Kumar Yadav
Hon'ble Krishan Pahal,J.
1.
List has been revised.
2. Short rejoinder affidavit filed by learned counsel for the applicant is taken on record.

3. Heard Sri Avinash Pandey, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Atmaram Nadiwal, learned counsel for the informant and Sri Sunil Kumar, learned A.G.A. for the State as well as perused the record.
4.

The present anticipatory bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant in Case Crime No.266 of 2023, registered under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471 I.P.C. at Police Station- Mandi,
District- Saharanpur with a prayer to enlarge him on anticipatory bail.

Baburam vs State Of U.P. on 17 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/163449782/
1

5. As per prosecution story, the informant is stated to have purchased the land in two transactions from another person and subsequent to it the applicant is stated to have purchased the said land on the basis of forged documents through a registered sale deed.
6. Learned counsel for the applicant has stated that he has been falsely implicated in this case.
The applicant is a bona fide purchaser and he himself has been duped of said hard earned money.

Learned counsel has stated that the applicant had filed a civil suit before the Civil Judge (Senior Division), Saharanpur which was registered as Original Suit No.884 of 2023 and temporary injunction was granted to him vide order dated 21.8.2023 in the said suit.
Learned counsel has stated that subsequent to the said order the present FIR has been instituted on 28.8.2023.
There is no criminal antecedent of the applicant.
7. Several other submissions have been made on behalf of the applicant to demonstrate the falsity of the allegations made against him.
The circumstances which, as per counsel, led to the false implication of the applicant have also been touched upon at length.
The applicant has apprehension of his arrest.

Learned counsel has stated that the applicant undertakes that he has co-operated in the investigation and is ready to do so in trial also failing which the State can move appropriate application for cancellation of anticipatory bail.

8. Per contra, learned counsel for the informant and learned A.G.A. have vehemently opposed the anticipatory bail application on the ground that the applicant is a land grabber and has forged the said documents.

Learned counsel for the informant has further stated that the informant used to live at Haridwar, and as such, did not have knowledge about the said forgery being committed by the applicant and after getting the information instituted the said FIR.
9.

On due consideration to the arguments advanced by learned counsels for the parties as well as learned A.G.A., considering the nature of accusations and antecedents of the applicant and taking into consideration that there is civil suit pending between the parties, the applicant is liable to be enlarged on anticipatory bail in view of the judgment of Supreme Court in the case of "Sushila Aggarwal Vs. State (NCT of Delhi), (2020) 5 SCC 1".

entities.text: Sushila Aggarwal Vs. State (NCT of Delhi), (2020) 5 SCC 1
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The future contingencies regarding the anticipatory bail being granted to applicant shall also be taken care of as per the aforesaid judgment of the Apex Court.
10. In view of the above, the anticipatory bail application of the applicant is allowed.

Let the accused-applicant- Baburam be released forthwith in the aforesaid case crime (supra) on anticipatory bail till the conclusion of trial on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i). that the applicant shall make himself available for interrogation by a police officer as and when required;
11. It is made clear that observations made hereinabove are exclusively for deciding the instant anticipatory bail application and shall not affect the trial.

Order Date :- 17.11.2023 Vikas [Krishan Pahal, J.]
